Name: Simple Shop Times
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[heading]Simple Shop Times[/heading]
Simple Shop Times adds a small wooden hanging sign above shop and NPC house doors when you stand in front of them.
The sign shows:
[list]
[*]Building name[/*]
[*]Opening and closing time[/*]
[*]Whether it is currently open or closed[/*]
[*]Regular closing days[/*]
[/list]Only one sign appears at a time, only when you are near and facing the door, so signs do not overlap or clutter the map.
It supports vanilla shops, service buildings, NPC homes, and configurable modded locations. Player-owned farm buildings are intentionally ignored, including the farmhouse, greenhouse, barns, coops, sheds, cabins, and farm cave.
Features
[list]
[*]Shows shop hours directly at the entrance[/*]
[*]Displays live open/closed status[/*]
[*]Shows weekly closing days[/*]
[*]Supports NPC homes and public buildings[/*]
[*]Compatible with map and location mods using normal door destinations[/*]
[*]Configure additional modded shops in
[code]config.json[/code][/*]
[*]12 languages supported:
English, Chinese, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.4.0+
